name: tell_me
title: Section C · an agent's run stays out of the stream, until the person asks to be told

steps.result: This is my first look at your Listings table, and it holds **2 listings**: Harbour Car Wash and Corner Print Shop. From the next run on, I'll tell you which listings are new by name.

steps.say: From now on, tell me here whenever Listing Watch finds a new listing.
steps.reply:
I've changed Listing Watch so it tells you about a new listing as soon as one is added to your Listings table. Before this, it only checked on Mondays at 09:00.

- **When it runs:** whenever a listing is added, and still every Monday at 09:00 as a backup.
- **What you'll see:** one line per new listing, with the business name and asking price.
- **When nothing is new:** it stays quiet.

You have two listings so far, Harbour Car Wash and Corner Print Shop, and those already count as seen. Only listings added from now on will set it off.

arg.contains: runs now come to the conversation
